name: empty-truncated-length
doc: FANG-13, second half: the OTHER exit that can end a turn with nothing to say. Every response is `finish_reason: length` with an empty content string, so the loop takes the StopReason::MaxTokens arm, pushes 'Please continue.' and asks again - MAX_CONTINUATIONS (5, agent_loop.rs) times, at which point the continuation budget is spent. Until this scenario existed that exit answered with '[Partial response - token limit reached with no text output.]' and HTTP 200: a runtime-authored sentence in the field where the model's answer belongs, on a turn where not one of the five responses carried a character - the same fabrication the empty-final-message exit stopped making, in a branch nobody had looked at. Exactly five calls per turn, no tools, no retry (the one-shot empty-response retry lives in the EndTurn arm and is never reached). Driver ../FANG-13.sh, phase B.
